Definition: to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic
BiblicalUsage: 1) to rise up, grow up, be exalted in triumph; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rise up; 1a2) to grow up; 1a3) to be lifted up, be raised up, be exalted
